popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius stages Cyzicus' tragedy in Book 1: the young Dolionian king hosts the Argonauts, then dies by Jason's hand in a night battle of mistaken identity — Cleite's suicide follows.

popCulture.title: Cyzicus (mythology)
popCulture.description: King of the Doliones on the Propontis — hospitality betrayed by fog and error; not the later city alone, nor every coin of Cyzicus.

popCulture.title: Jason
popCulture.description: The guest who kills his host in the dark — Cyzicus' death is Jason's first great pollution on the Argo's outward voyage.

popCulture.title: Jason and the Argonauts
popCulture.creator: Don Chaffey
popCulture.description: Harryhausen's peplum keeps the Propontis voyage in the Argonaut cycle — Cyzicus' mistimed battle among the episodes the film compresses.
